name: Multiple customers sharing contact details or addresses
description: Unrelated customers or applicants share the same phone, email, address, device or bank account, including mail drops and shared accommodation.
fp: Family members, flatmates, student housing and shared workplaces legitimately share details.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach to Prepaid Cards, Mobile Payments and Internet-Based Payment Services (2013)

links.name: Multiple cards sharing identifiers
links.ctx: Different cardholders share phone, address, email or device.

links.name: Same contact details used with different identities
links.ctx: Phone or email repeated under varied names or birthdates. Many identities share one address or commercial drop.

links.name: Benefit claimants share bank accounts or addresses
links.ctx: Many claims route to same accounts or addresses.

links.name: Multiple unrelated accounts opened with the same address or phone
links.ctx: Several new customers share contact details, often in accommodation used to house workers.
links.fp: Shared households, student housing and hostels create shared addresses.
